comment: timeout.c nh_timeout() SICK 713-719: a debug dwarvish Valkyrie wishes for a cursed Oracle corpse, drops it, waits about 190 turns (#wizkill removes a newt that interrupts) and eats it: 'Ulch - that meat was tainted!' makes her deathly sick with the killer 'the Oracle's rotted corpse'. When the illness runs out, name_to_mon() finds the Oracle, who is G_UNIQ without M2_PNAME, so the killer is prefixed with the() and the format becomes KILLED_BY (718-719). ESC answers the wizard-mode 'Die?' with no, and the last ESC dismisses the message.
